reviews.text: Very clean and tidy environment, equipped with everything and very attentive and helpful staff, I found myself very comfortable and it solved problems for my dog ​​that I have not satisfied with elsewhere.
Qualified, friendly and helpful staff

Dr. Sinigaglia's entire team is exceptional. I wanted to thank you for your work over the years for our dog, who sadly is no longer with us. Your kindness and presence right up to the end. Unlike other clinics, they don't work just for money, but because they truly care about our best friends. A special thanks to Dr. Agnello, who cared for our Trifola.
Attentive welcome, high professionalism
A thousand thanks

I can't say enough about the doctor's kindness and professionalism.
We called her 10 minutes before closing time because our dog was limping. She told us to come right away and examined her.
Luckily, it wasn't serious, just an abrasion. She gave us all the necessary treatment instructions and didn't ask for any compensation.
I had already contacted her a few years ago and had such an excellent professional response that I even recommended her to friends with a small dachshund, who obviously had a great experience.
I can only reiterate my recommendation to trust her.
A thousand thanks
We had a great time, they are kind, knowledgeable and understanding!

Competent doctors and fairly fast service. Prices are in line with those of other veterinary clinics.
It's the best clinic I've ever dealt with. They're always available, present, and very attentive to the animals' well-being. I adore Dr. Di Fiore, but the entire team is a strength and a value.

Tidy place, overwhelmingly positive feedback...it's now become our trusted veterinary practice...we've actually followed our own vet. The emails for vaccination reminders are effective...but a 30-day reminder is better...and not just a week in advance.

Our two French bulldogs have been cared for by the clinic staff since they were puppies. We have often needed the care of Dr. Di Fiore in particular. Recently, we needed special assistance following two very serious and, unfortunately, very close diagnoses. Even though Dr. Di Fiore was on vacation, she was very available to answer questions and pass the information on to her colleague, Blanca, an ultrasound specialist. She reviewed the documentation on a holiday and responded to us as well. We thank both of them for their availability, expertise, and the compassion with which they have always treated us. Please do not hesitate to contact this clinic.

In a time of emergency, I was greeted with a kindness and sensitivity that deeply touched me. Despite the urgency, I was admitted the same day, and they did everything necessary with great care and attention. A truly rare humanity and professionalism. Thank you so much for being there when we really needed it. Unforgettable.

Unfortunately, being in a hurry, I didn't ask the very kind doctor's name.
Having worked with Dr. Sinigaglia on another occasion, I would like to express my sincere gratitude for the professionalism, kindness, and attention I received during the visit. The doctor was able to put not only my dog, but me as well, at ease, explaining everything clearly and with great humanity. It's rare to find such a perfect balance between competence and compassion. Thank you so much for welcoming us with such care and respect.
A thousand thanks
The clinic isn't particularly large, but it's comprehensive and well-equipped. Above all, the vets are excellent, competent, and also kind and helpful.
Top-notch service and availability for a veterinary center that prioritizes love and care for our little friends over mere financial considerations. Highly recommended.

I've known Dr. Sinigaglia since her first practice on the island, and a lot has happened since then! For any issue, I've always been able to turn to her, knowing I'd find expertise and empathy (as well as fair prices). Even now that the practice has expanded and offers many more services, professionalism continues to set the entire staff apart.
Thank you so much Cristina.

The best doctor and team in terms of expertise, professionalism, and attention to our dog and his needs. They always help us, his owners, understand his ailments, and explain the recovery process and possible prevention options clearly and helpfully. We feel safe in their hands.

Loving with their patients and very thorough. Their advice is treasured.
